$comment: The starting point for every new kit: `npm run newkit -- <id> --name <Name> --color <element>` copies it, drops every $comment, stamps the id, the next free card number and `unreleased: true`. Never start from another character's file (his rule, 2026-10-13). Every value here is a placeholder for his draft; he owns every name, number and mechanic. The schema is lib/game/characterSchema.ts (data/kit.schema.json for editors); the design rules and stat bands are docs/design/KIT_DESIGN.md; wording is the kitwords skill, the audit is kitcheck.
name: New Character
heading: A Title Above The Name
lore: One or two sentences for the archive.

skills.$comment: Skill 1. `type` fixes the card colour (attack red, attackDebuff purple, buff blue, debuff purple, heal green, stance yellow). `damageRanked` is [R1, R2, R3] % of `statMultiplier`; a non-damage skill carries [0, 0, 0]. One mechanic entry per effect, in the order they apply; a self-buff before the hit boosts the hit (ruling #22).
skills.description: Raises ATK for 1 turn; then does damage equal to ATK-scaled to one enemy.

mechanics.$comment: Flat magnitude, flat duration: his draft wrote them unbracketed. `targetSelf` is the legacy spelling of applyTo: self.

skills.$comment: Skill 2. A rank-scaled magnitude is `valueRanked` and a rank-scaled duration is `durationRanked`, each [R1, R2, R3]; `applyToRanked` widens the audience by rank. `aoe` means every enemy on the field.
skills.description: Does damage equal to ATK-scaled to all enemies and lowers their DEF for [debuff.duration] turns.

ultimate.$comment: No ranks. `damage` is the flat % and `damageByUltLevel` the six-step ladder for ult levels 1 to 6 (ruling #92); an NPC or boss carries `damage` alone.
ultimate.description: Does damage equal to ATK-scaled to one enemy.

passive.$comment: Single-block shorthand: one `trigger` and its `mechanics`. Several condition headings use `blocks` instead (each with its own trigger, heading and mechanics). `description` is markdown in the game's voice: `# When ...` headings, `- ` bullets, 👆 / 👇, (Max N), (Uncancellable). `worksFromSub` defaults to false.
passive.name: Steady Hands
